title: Staging Auto Pilot bootstrap self-update and provenance guard

phases.objective: Ensure every local Staging Auto Pilot entrypoint synchronizes and reloads the exact eligible main commit before execution, while preserving ignored local secrets and fail-closing on dirty or incomplete provenance state.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Staging operator and governed CI
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The portable Staging CMD launcher or Auto Pilot entrypoint starts from an existing local checkout.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact eligible main commit is checked out before the loaded deployment script runs; provenance generation and Compose validation are reached only with the current contract-aware scripts.
steps: Reject a dirty working tree before bootstrap checkout so local work is never overwritten.
Fetch origin/main and checkout the exact eligible commit in detached mode.
Verify the reloaded launcher and Auto Pilot contain the provenance contract markers.
Preserve the ignored .env.staging file and existing non-empty secrets.
Run eligibility, exact Git context generation, Compose validation, build/reuse, certification, and readback.
Keep Production deployment, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, database migration, and provider mutation disabled.
assertions: The CMD launcher bootstraps through the tracked self-update shim rather than loading a stale local One-Click script directly.
The Auto Pilot entrypoint self-updates and reloads the exact commit before local Docker or WSL checks and before Compose validation.
The outermost One-Click/Bootstrap process owns the named mutex and explicitly propagates inherited-lock state to child processes, preventing overlapping checkout/build runs.
Every entrypoint verifies the canonical GitHub origin identity before fetch, checkout, eligibility, or environment initialization.
A dirty working tree fails closed without checkout or overwrite, after only the narrowly scoped quarantine of known Auto Pilot backup files.
Missing provenance markers fail closed before Compose execution.
Environment writes use UTF-8 without a BOM so Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot corrupt Docker Compose dotenv parsing.
Existing .env.staging values are not rotated or emitted as evidence.
The resulting build context remains exact Git archive content with secrets_included=false.
No Production mutation, migration, grant, provider mutation, or force push is introduced.
